explanation.explanation: Panel A is a 3D segmented tomographic rendering (cartoon-like reconstruction) of the apical end of a sporozoite showing preconoidal rings and actin filaments; it is not a quantitative plot with axes, so axis units are not applicable.
Panel B is a 3D segmented tomographic rendering of the basal end of a sporozoite showing membranes and actin bundles; it is a structural rendering, not a graph with quantitative axes.
Panel C is a slice through a cryo-electron tomogram (micrograph) with an accompanying scale bar (100 nm), not a plot with labeled axes.
Panel D is a schematic/cartoon illustration of a lateral section of a sporozoite showing labeled structures (nuclear, cytosolic, pellicular actin); it is not a quantitative plot requiring axis units.
Panel E is a slice through an averaged tomographic volume (micrograph-like image) with a scale bar (25 nm), not a graph with quantitative axes.
Panel F is a slice through a cryo-electron tomogram (micrograph) with a scale bar (50 nm) showing a pellicular actin filament and connecting densities; it is not a quantitative plot with axes.
